svg.title: Reading a tile path
svg.desc: The path tile/0/x001/x234/067.p/8 split into parts: tile is the namespace, 0 is the level, x001/x234/067 is the index 1,234,067 written in groups of three digits with an x on every group but the last, and .p/8 marks a partial tile holding 8 hashes. Without the suffix the tile is full, 256 hashes.

text.tspan: groups of three digits keep every directory under 1,000 names;
the x marks a directory, so 001 (a file) and x001 (a folder) never collide.
no suffix: a full tile, 256 hashes, 8,192 bytes, never changes.
